headline: Copper Futures Resume Fall Toward $5.50 per Pound on Demand Concerns
summary: Copper futures fell to around $5.50 per pound as early equity relief lost momentum, weighed down by persistent concerns over Chinese industrial demand and elevated US interest rate expectations.
why: Copper is widely used in power, manufacturing, and construction, making it an economic indicator for industrial growth.

impacts.name: Copper
impacts.why: Copper futures fell toward $5.50 per pound on renewed concerns regarding demand in China.
